title: Chick eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='30' ry='6' fill='#2b4a3a'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='26' ry='27' fill='#f7d43c'/>
  <!-- body shading -->
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='66' rx='18' ry='16' fill='#f0b52e'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='18' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- wing left -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='62' rx='8' ry='13' fill='#f0b52e' transform='rotate(15 27 62)'/>
  <!-- wing right -->
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='62' rx='8' ry='13' fill='#f0b52e' transform='rotate(-15 73 62)'/>
  <!-- eye left -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='28' r='4' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='27' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- eye right -->
  <circle cx='57' cy='28' r='4' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='27' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- beak open, top -->
  <path d='M44 40 L50 36 L56 40 L50 42 Z' fill='#ff9a1f'/>
  <!-- beak open, bottom -->
  <path d='M44 44 L50 48 L56 44 L50 42 Z' fill='#e07d0e'/>
  <!-- snack bread in beak -->
  <rect x='47' y='39' width='12' height='8' rx='2' fill='#c96f2a'/>
  <rect x='48' y='40' width='10' height='3' rx='1' fill='#e8a15a'/>
  <!-- crumbs -->
  <circle cx='62' cy='50' r='1.5' fill='#e8a15a'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='52' r='1.2' fill='#e8a15a'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <path d='M38 86 L32 92 L44 92 Z' fill='#ff9a1f'/>
  <path d='M62 86 L56 92 L68 92 Z' fill='#ff9a1f'/>
  <!-- little tuft -->
  <path d='M48 15 Q50 8 54 14' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
